statement: The lane credential has exactly two consumers in FHS_NEXT: start-router.ps1 (credentialPath) and ops/r1_host_readback.py.
Both consumers read a *file path*, so rotation is a path/content change, not a code change.
The router substitutes ${OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY} at process start; a running router keeps the old key until restarted.
A direct HTTPS probe of the provider's /v1/models returned 403 for both old and new keys, so it cannot be used as a validity test.
The conclusive validity test is a codex exec call with model_provider=opencode_go and model deepseek-v4.1-flash returning CHECKER_OK.
The 3LM dispatcher refuses to spawn when its declared codex binary pin no longer exists (ERR_LANE_PIN_IDENTITY_INVALID).
Credentials must never appear in argv, logs, evidence, commits or replies.
Fabric entry is navigation only (effect_permission=NONE); an unknown route holds only the affected write.
Rotation should be one command that (a) rewrites the pointer, (b) restarts the consumer, (c) runs a positive probe, (d) writes a redacted receipt.
The same command shape should cover toolchain (codex binary) pin refresh, because it fails the same way.
